feeds.title: London On The Inside
feeds.description: London On The Inside is a lifestyle guide for curious Londoners. LOTI unlocks the best places to eat, drink, shop and do in London and surrounds. Giving you news, reviews and recommendations on discoveries, experiences and those hidden gems.

feeds.title: i Heart Berlin
feeds.description: Relive the galvanizing Berlin atmosphere through beautifully told experiences and outdoor stories. The iHeartBerlin Blog captures the unique vibe of the city, documenting the current ongoing with all its ups and downs and changes it has been going through.

feeds.title: My Parisian Life
feeds.description: This website can help you find a romantic restaurant, activities with your kids, plan your next visit, discover places and treasures or share practical information on life in Paris.

feeds.title: SilverSpoon London
feeds.description: SilverSpoon London is a fun and fabulous blog fusing London life, foodie adventures and luxury travel. The blog gives a low down on Londons hottest new restaurants as well as cool and inspiring destinations globally.

feeds.title: Megan Ellaby
feeds.description: A Fashion & Lifestyle Blog authored by Best Fashion Influencer and Style Blogger Megan Ellaby.

feeds.title: Poppy Loves
feeds.description: A London lifestyle blog full of food, fashion, culture, craft, design and fun, and frolics. The Founder Poppy makes her way around London, armed with a camera, reviewing cafes, boutiques, hotels and fun, hidden parts of London.

feeds.title: AfroCosmopolitan
feeds.description: No.1 Black & Afrocentric Online Magazine. For News, Entertainment, Fashion, Lifestyle & More!

feeds.title: Lily Kitten
feeds.description: Full time I'm an ambitious International Marketing Manger for Beauty, in my part time I'm an enthusiastic British Fashion, Beauty and Lifestyle blogger and YouTuber from Manchester, UK.

feeds.title: Come Here To Me!
feeds.description: Come Here To Me! is a group blog that focuses on the life and culture of Dublin city. Music, history, football, politics and pub crawls all feature, along with much more.

feeds.title: GLOSE
feeds.description: Glose is a lifestyle blog, a blog of trends, ideas for outings to Paris, moments of life, and mood tickets.

feeds.title: The British Berliner Blog
feeds.description: The British Berliner is a lifestyle expat travel blog about culture, history, travels around the world, Europe, and being British in Berlin. It will focus on a British girl from Manchester living in Berlin, her promotion of British-German life, culture, history, literature, theatre, style, Europe, travels around the world, what she does in normal everyday life and where she goes.

feeds.title: AngiesWeb.com
feeds.description: Angie's Web is a charming lifestyle and travel blog focused on German traditions, cuisine, regional travel, and cultural heritage, offering readers a nostalgic glimpse into Germany's past and present through stories, photos, and recipes.

feeds.title: Megan Ellaby
feeds.description: Megan Ellaby is a twenty-something Mancunian with a huge love for colour and print. She showcases her outfits, and chats about fashion and what is inspiring her, along with her two sausage dogs Peter and Nancy, her huge passion for interior design, travel, music and her love for her hometown of Manchester. Check out her blog for fashion and lifestyle in Manchester.

feeds.title: Side Street Style
feeds.description: A family travel and lifestyle blog

feeds.title: Andysparkles
feeds.description: andysparkles is a personal lifestyle, beauty and fashion blog from Berlin. Andrea Funk reports on fashion and beauty, travel and interior, DIY, hotels and cats.

feeds.title: Valencian
feeds.description: Valencia News is an online news site that features the most recent headlines from Valencia, La Comunidad Valenciana, and Spain in general. We publish not only news about daily life in Valencia, but also news about business, tourism, real estate, entertainment, lifestyle, and events, with a special focus on foreigners living here as well as people preparing to make the move.

feeds.title: I Want You To Know
feeds.description: It's a personal fashion, lifestyle & travel blog by London‑based blogger Kristabel Plummer, offering style tips, city guides, self‑reflection posts and creative essays about making the most of life in the city and beyond

feeds.title: Pippa
feeds.description: Pippa is one of Ireland's best known models. She set up pippa.ie in 2013, a popular fashion, beauty & lifestyle blog.

feeds.title: Powder Rooms
feeds.description: Powder Rooms is formerly the 10 year strong What Emma Did blog, which has now re-launched to become a UK lifestyle, wellness, fashion, beauty, and self-care online hub. Powder Rooms is based in Manchester. written for ladies all around the world. Our editor & founder, Emma Campbell, is also a Makeup Artist covering Manchester, Cheshire, and Staffordshire.

feeds.title: So Sue Me Blog
feeds.description: Award-winning blogger turned businesswoman, Suzanne Jackson, is the brains behind one of Ireland's leading fashion, beauty and lifestyle blog SoSueMe.ie.

feeds.title: TRAUMODE
feeds.description: Take a peek into the current contemporary fashion scene, wellness trends, cultural affairs, and relationships. TRAUMODE is a European lifestyle and fashion platform based in Istanbul. Focusing on fashion, culture, sustainability, wellness, and love; the platform promotes a multidisciplinary vision of the contemporary scene.

feeds.title: Luso Life
feeds.description: Luso Life is a magazine created primarily by Portuguese-Canadians, giving you a view of what we find interesting. Get articles about arts and culture, food, music, style, people.

feeds.title: Comfort Zone Blog
feeds.description: Comfort Zone is a personal lifestyle blog from Hamburg. Blogger Jana Kalea writes about fashion, travel, food and Hamburg content.

feeds.title: Bistro Chic
feeds.description: Bistro Chic is a petite collection of musings related to world travel and culture and how we can make small lifestyle changes to bring more joie de vivre (joy of living) into our everyday lives.

feeds.title: Les Berlinettes
feeds.description: My name is Amandine. Les Berlinettes is my lifestyle, fashion and travel blog. I have always been interested in Fashion and it is for me here the place to share the work of my favorite designers, shopping tips and my personal style and my beauty favourites.

feeds.title: A Parisienne Life
feeds.description: A Parisienne Life is a personal lifestyle blog by Julie Maarhuis that invites Francophiles and travelers to embrace the everyday beauty of Paris—from fashion and beauty to hidden gems and Parisian lifestyle tips—with insider travel guides and chic inspiration.
